parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation or general facility ban, and transphobia is an aggravating factor, but conditional severity if outed is high. Custody placement by documents/birth sex with isolation and strip-search exposure is documented as persistent in 2010 and 2021 oversight opinions with no improvement, and a 2024-25 case confirms continued men's-prison isolation—repeated oversight without a working remedy, not mitigation. A 2023 survey cited by the ombudsman finds 64% of trans people report identity-related discrimination, a majority prevalence signal, with guidance issued but no documented effective correction of outcomes. A 2017 border humiliation account is dated and single, so border risk is uncertain. Subnational overseas differences are LGB acceptance only, with no trans-specific findings. Multiple unremedied institutional exposures place this in elevated risk, below reduced-risk tiers with working protections.
